fieldValues.title: Problems and counter-evidence
fieldValues.summary: A paragraph can be linked to the problem it speaks to, and to sources and quotations that support or oppose it. Your AI can suggest these links; you decide which stay.
fieldValues.ai_guidance: create a source, quotation or problem in references, then link it to the paragraph; the agent brief says which relation does what. Suggest and let the writer decide. Offer this when the writer is making an argument; a story or a contract may not need it.
